summary: Main-road kerb with no parked cars and houses 2-9 m away along it.
reasons: Main road, no cars parked here

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 2 m and 4 m, apartments 7 m and 9 m, and a house 8 m from the kerb, all on the same side.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs along a busy intersection approach; no verge or pull-in, nowhere to get fully off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Carmody Road through route with junctions at both ends; steady traffic and noise.
drivers.convention: No cars parked on this north kerb in either image; parking is on the south side.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m for the whole length
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees at the west end shade the morning.
